resolution_notes: example.response_snippet: ORIGINAL STANDS. Official artist.getInfo sample response uses stats.plays (not playcount): https://www.last.fm/api/show/artist.getInfo shows <stats><listeners>196440</listeners><plays>1599101</plays></stats>. Auditor likely confused with track.getInfo, which uses playcount. JSON maps the XML element name, so stats.plays is correct.
